candidates.source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (VVZ) – national public procurement bulletin
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory national publication point for contract notices and contract award notices above thresholds under Act 134/2016 Sb. Notices for payment terminal operation, card acquiring, ATM services and cash logistics carry estimated/awarded values, quantities, durations and the winning supplier – hard numbers on volumes and incumbents that are otherwise unpublished in a private banking market. Confirmed example seen in search: 'Realizace provozu platebních terminálů pro CS ČR 2017' (Customs Administration), evidence no. Z2017-017645.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login for viewing notices
candidates.legal_status: official public register; statutory publication duty
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword + CPV-code search (e.g. 66110000 banking, 66172000 financial transaction processing, 30123400/30144200 ticketing and payment machines, 79710000 security/cash-in-transit); harvest notice pages and linked award notices; prefer the ISVZ open-data exports over HTML scraping where available
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query + snowball from Czech procurement portal descriptions
queries_used: Věstník veřejných zakázek platební terminály akceptace platebních karet zakázka
otevřená data Věstník veřejných zakázek ISVZ open data

candidates.source_name: ISVZ – Informační systém o veřejných zakázkách (statistics, dashboards, open data)
candidates.why_relevant: The analytical layer over VVZ: interactive dashboards, static reports on the Czech public procurement market and OpenData datasets plus classifier lists (CPV). Lets the whole tender corpus be filtered by CPV to quantify how much the state spends on payment acceptance, ATM and cash-handling services and which suppliers win.
candidates.legal_status: state-run information system, open data licence
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk download of OpenData exports, then CPV/keyword filtering into a local warehouse; refresh monthly
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on open data for VVZ
queries_used: otevřená data Věstník veřejných zakázek ISVZ open data ted.europa.eu API export

candidates.source_name: NEN – Národní elektronický nástroj (National Electronic Tool)
candidates.why_relevant: State e-procurement platform used by ministries, state enterprises and sectoral contracting authorities; full tender documentation (technical specifications, quantities, service levels) is downloadable without registration for many contracts. Confirmed relevant example found: 'Poskytování bezpečnostních služeb chráněné pozemní přepravy hotovosti a cenin a zpracování hotovosti II.' (N006-20-V00030707) – cash-in-transit and cash-processing services with dates and scope.
candidates.access_status: public browsing; supplier registration only needed to bid
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search NEN 'Veřejné zakázky' by Czech keywords and CPV; fetch detail pages (stable /verejne-zakazky/detail-zakazky/N###-##-V######## URLs) and attached zadávací dokumentace PDFs
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query
queries_used: NEN nen.nipez.cz veřejná zakázka svoz hotovosti zpracování hotovosti

candidates.source_name: Věstník NEN

candidates.why_relevant: Reference layer: thresholds, CPV nomenclature and form structures needed to build correct filters for the Czech tender corpus. Not a data source itself but determines what is capturable.

candidates.why_relevant: Regulatory list of banknote-handling machines (ATMs, recyclers, sorters) that passed ČNB testing. Effectively a vendor/model census of the cash-handling equipment legally usable in CZ – reveals which manufacturers and machine families are deployed, a strong complement to tender documents.

candidates.source_name: Registr smluv (smlouvy.gov.cz) – public register of contracts
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register where public bodies must publish the actual signed contracts (including annexes). Card-acquiring contracts and merchant manuals of Czech acquirers are visible in full text there (e.g. acquiring contract annex 'Manuál pro obchodníky' documents). Gives real pricing/fee schedules, terminal counts and service terms that tender notices omit.
candidates.legal_status: statutory register (Act 340/2015 Sb.); note metadata contain personal data – GDPR controller duties on re-use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download monthly open-data dumps of contract metadata, filter by keywords (akceptace platebních karet, svoz hotovosti, bankomat, terminál), then fetch the attached PDFs for the shortlisted contracts
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on registr smluv open data
queries_used: registr smluv smlouvy.gov.cz otevřená data API smlouva akceptace platebních karet

candidates.source_name: Hlídač státu – tender and contract aggregator with open API
candidates.why_relevant: Independent NGO aggregator that indexes the contract register, the public procurement register and ÚOHS decisions into one searchable corpus with a documented API, and links records to companies by IČO. By far the cheapest way to run cross-source keyword monitoring on payment/ATM/cash tenders and to map supplier-buyer relationships.
candidates.access_status: public web; API requires a free token
candidates.legal_status: third-party aggregator of public data; check API terms before bulk re-use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use API v2 (documented at /api/v1/doc) for saved keyword queries and IČO-based supplier/buyer lookups; treat as index, verify hits against VVZ/NEN/registr smluv originals
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on aggregators
queries_used: hlídač státu hlidacstatu.cz API veřejné zakázky registr smluv data

negative_findings.description: No public tender route exists for the ATM estates of commercial Czech banks (Česká spořitelna, ČSOB, Komerční banka, Moneta, Air Bank, UniCredit, Raiffeisenbank). They are private entities not covered by Act 134/2016 Sb., so their ATM supply, cash-in-transit and processing contracts are not published in VVZ/NEN/TED.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language searches for 'veřejná zakázka bankomaty' returned only ČNB/state records and ÚOHS competition material, no bank-issued tender notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The largest share of Czech ATM and acquiring volume is therefore invisible to this workstream; A4 tender routes cover the state, post, transport and municipal segment only, and bank-side numbers must come from ČNB statistics or ÚOHS/merger filings instead.

negative_findings.description: Attempts to reach a specific Czech Post tender for cash/valuables transport via Tender Arena search did not surface such a contract; only unrelated Czech Post contracts (mobile apps, handling equipment, barcode readers) appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two TED notices for Czech Post (486371-2020, 525527-2020) were surfaced as PDFs but their subject matter was not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Czech Post is the single most important non-bank cash node in CZ; failure to locate its cash-logistics tenders is a coverage risk, not evidence that none exist.

negative_findings.description: No fetch of TED, NEN, VVZ, Tender Arena or E-ZAK pages was performed in this pass; all URLs come from search results only and none is claimed reachable. TED and Tender Arena in particular are known to be JavaScript-heavy and may return 403 or empty shells to simple fetchers.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should assume an API/bulk-download route for TED and NEN rather than HTML scraping.

negative_findings.description: No settled Czech-language term was identified for 'cash recycler' or 'deposit-taking ATM' beyond the colloquial 'vkladomat'; 'bankomat' is used broadly and 'vkladomat' appears mostly in consumer media rather than tender language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Tender-grade phrasing for recycling ATMs remains unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword monitoring may miss recycler tenders phrased as 'zařízení pro zpracování bankovek' or by CPV code only.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal and regional buyers (cities, kraje, municipal transport companies outside Prague and Olomouc, parking operators, waterworks, hospitals) were only sampled, not enumerated. Each runs its own profile, so the long tail of POS/CIT tenders is unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate contracting authorities by IČO via Hlídač státu and the VVZ profile registry, then run standing keyword queries per authority rather than per platform.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list was fixed for this domain in this pass; keyword-only search will under-recall tenders titled generically (e.g. 'bezpečnostní služby' covering CIT).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and pin a CPV set (66110000, 66172000, 79710000, 30123400, 30144200, 48000000 subsets) and drive TED/VVZ/NEN harvesting from codes plus keywords.

coverage_gaps.description: Confirmed examples cluster in 2017-2021; no 2024-2026 payment/cash tender was verified in this pass, so current incumbents and current volumes are not evidenced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dated sweep of TED CZ notices and NEN Věstník for the last 24 months before drawing any incumbent-share conclusions.

coverage_gaps.description: Legal/re-use terms of the commercial aggregators (Tender Arena, vhodne-uverejneni, openprocurements, najdivz) and of the Hlídač státu API were not reviewed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review each platform's terms and API licence before automated collection; default to the official VVZ/NEN/TED/registr smluv originals for anything reused in deliverables.

brief: Czech public-tender routes are unusually rich for this sector because the official layer is fully digital and mandatory: VVZ (vvz.nipez.cz) plus its analytical/open-data twin ISVZ, the state e-procurement platform NEN, the EU duplicate on TED, and — uniquely valuable — the Registr smluv, which publishes the signed contracts and annexes themselves, including acquiring contracts and merchant fee manuals. Around those sit contracting-authority profiles (E-ZAK instances for ČNB and Správa železnic, Tender Arena for Česká pošta and Dopravní podnik hl. m. Prahy) and two strong secondary layers: Hlídač státu, which indexes contracts, tenders and ÚOHS decisions behind one documented API, and ÚOHS itself, whose review decisions and competition analyses restate tender volumes and ATM-network economics in detail. The hard numbers this cell can yield are cash-processing volumes at ČNB, CIT frequencies and site counts at hospitals/post/municipalities, and terminal fleet counts at transport operators; the structural blind spot is that commercial banks are outside the procurement regime entirely, so their ATM and acquiring estates never appear here. Priority next steps are pinning a CPV code set and running a 24-month recency sweep, since the confirmed examples found so far are mostly 2017-2021.
